result:
Admins can now rename their team from the profile page. I didn't run tests, lint or the app, so none of it has been checked. The lint hook flagged the `'ADMIN'` string in the Rename button's role check, and I changed it to `ROLES.ADMIN`.

- **API:** `features/teams/api/update-team.ts` holds a Zod schema for the new name, the `PATCH /teams/{teamId}` call and a `useUpdateTeam` hook. The hook refreshes the teams list and shows a "Team Renamed" success notification, since the feature rules put success messages in the hook.
- **Rename button:** `features/teams/components/rename-team.tsx` shows a Rename button inside an `<Authorization>` check for admins. It opens a form drawer with a Team Name field.
- **Team section:** `features/teams/components/team-section.tsx` shows the team name with the Rename button beside it. `app/routes/app/profile.tsx` renders it below the user card, passing in the user's team id.
- **Mock API:** I added a `PATCH /teams/:teamId` handler to `testing/mocks/handlers/teams.ts`. It requires an admin and only lets them rename their own team.

I haven't confirmed the section shows the team name. It looks the team up in the full teams list returned by `GET /teams`.
